description: This Java class 'LoanDownPaymentTransactionValidator' provides validation methods for loan down payment transactions within the loan account module of the Fineract project. It includes checks for repayment dates on non-working days or holidays, loan status validation, and account state validation based on different loan events.

classes.name: LoanDownPaymentTransactionValidator
classes.description: A validator class for loan down payment transactions which performs various business rule validations related to loan repayment dates, statuses, and account states.

methods.name: validateRepaymentDateIsOnNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Validates that the repayment date is on a working day unless transactions on non-working days are allowed.

methods.name: validateRepaymentDateIsOnHoliday
methods.description: Checks if the repayment date falls on a holiday when holidays are not allowed for transactions.

methods.name: validateLoanStatusIsActiveOrFullyPaidOrOverpaid
methods.description: Ensures the loan status is either active, fully paid, or overpaid before proceeding.

methods.name: validateRepaymentTypeAccountStatus
methods.description: Validates the account status based on the type of repayment transaction and current loan state.

methods.name: validateAccountStatus
methods.description: Performs detailed validation of the loan's current state against specific loan events, raising validation errors if conditions are not met.
